title: Treaty of Adrianople (1713)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Adrianople (1713)", at revision 1316577518, opens: "The Treaty of Adrianople, also called the Treaty of Edirne, was signed on 24 June 1713 between the Ottoman Empire and the Tsardom of Russia and confirmed the Treaty of the Pruth of 1711, which had ended the Pruth River Campaign (1710–1711)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q700238, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1713 treaty between Russia and the Ottomans". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
